summary: The Gabelli Healthcare & WellnessRx Trust filed an 8-K reporting that Mario J. Gabelli, Chairman and CIO, was hospitalized on March 19, 2026, and his return timeline is unknown. GAMCO Investors, Inc. activated its succession plan, naming Christopher J. Marangi as President on March 22, 2026. Douglas R. Jamieson and Mr. Marangi lead day-to-day operations, while Kevin V. Dreyer and Mr. Marangi co-manage the fund's portfolio. This is an abrupt, health-driven management change with no deal terms. Watch for further updates on Mr. Gabelli's condition and any governance impacts.
